history_coverage: Repository demonstrations plus this batch only; live channel catalog import pending upload-capable connection
duplicate_detection: Exact topic keys, scripts, titles/aliases and conservative fuzzy wording checks; new agents must also compare premises and development semantically

topics.title: What if Naruto joined the Akatsuki?
topics.premise: Naruto joins the Akatsuki and faces their intentions toward Kurama and Konoha
topics.distinctive_development: Earlier Naruto tests and alternate engineering cuts all share this premise

topics.title: What if Goku joined the Avengers? The budget is cooked.
topics.premise: Goku joins the Avengers, disrupting their teamwork, food budget and Thanos confrontation
topics.distinctive_development: Food budget and training partner jokes with a grocery-card callback

topics.title: What if Naruto's shadow clones went on strike?
topics.premise: Naruto must negotiate with his own shadow clones instead of treating them as disposable labor.
topics.distinctive_development: Work stoppage interrupts missions; clones share his exhaustion and grievances; negotiation changes tactical training; the original joins his own strike.

topics.title: What if Rock Lee woke up with the Rinnegan?
topics.premise: Rock Lee receives unfamiliar ocular powers but discovers that discipline and restraint matter more than collecting abilities.
topics.distinctive_development: Accidental attraction disrupts training; Guy insists on control; Lee practices precision and saves teammates rather than stacking maximal powers.

topics.title: What if Shikamaru had ONE day to fix Konoha?
topics.premise: Shikamaru runs the village for one day and solves mundane bottlenecks instead of searching for a flashy new attack.
topics.distinctive_development: Visible crisis becomes logistics problem; assignment timing and supply chains improve; apparent laziness is prevention; leadership also demands listening.

topics.title: What if Luffy NEVER ate a Devil Fruit?
topics.premise: Luffy pursues his pirate dream without rubber powers and must learn rescue, crew dependence and a different fighting style.
topics.distinctive_development: Remove powers without erasing ambition; swimming gives one advantage but fists lose protection; teamwork and equipment become necessary; no automatic victory claim.

topics.title: What if Zoro finally learned directions?
topics.premise: Zoro stops getting lost, reaches threats before his crew and learns that arriving first can be a tactical disadvantage.
topics.distinctive_development: Navigation gag becomes timing problem; early arrival exposes ambush; retreat and rendezvous beat reckless solo fighting; map is a sword joke payoff.

topics.title: What if Light had to explain EVERY name to L?
topics.premise: A supernatural rule forces Light to defend each proposed notebook entry to L before it can take effect.
topics.distinctive_development: Forced justification exposes missing evidence and arrogance; accusation becomes investigation; L challenges selective justice; satire ends on documentation.

topics.title: What if Vegeta had one peaceful week?
topics.premise: Vegeta gets a week without a world-ending enemy and must decide what his strength is for when nobody needs defeating.
topics.distinctive_development: Compulsive training meets family time; rivalry habit interrupts peace; he learns intentional restraint while retaining competitive personality.

topics.title: What if Levi's cleaning day became a survival drill?
topics.premise: Levi converts an apparently petty cleaning inspection into practical equipment checks and team safety training.
topics.distinctive_development: Complaints about chores reveal frayed gear; checking equipment and communication improve odds without removing the danger; darkest humor stays non-graphic.

topics.title: What if Gojo lost his powers for 24 hours?
topics.premise: Gojo temporarily loses his technique and must protect students through planning, restraint and collaboration.
topics.distinctive_development: An invented one-day limit removes usual tools; students disagree about rescue; decoy and evacuation replace overpowering; weakness reveals teaching habits.

topics.title: What if Tanjiro could hear demons' thoughts?
topics.premise: Tanjiro gains hypothetical access to demon thoughts and learns that empathy is useful but thoughts do not guarantee honesty or harmlessness.
topics.distinctive_development: New information creates sensory overload; a deceptive thought challenges naive trust; corroboration and boundaries allow compassion with protection.
